user_query: My family and I are planning a vacation to Hawaii next month. Can you provide us with the weather forecast for the entire week? We would also like to know the air quality in Honolulu and the radiation forecast for the same period. Additionally, give us some historical weather records for the past month.

TaskList.description: Get the weather forecast for Hawaii for the entire week.
Check the air quality index in Honolulu for the same week.
Obtain the radiation forecast for Honolulu for the upcoming week.
Retrieve historical weather records for Hawaii for the past month.
